in_marathi.name: Sharvanda
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love and Fertility
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvanda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharvanda is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Sharva (god of love and fertility) and Anda (egg), symbolizing the divine mother who nurtures the universe. This name is believed to bestow love, happiness, and fertility.
